# LT4All

> LT4All is a conference series dedicated to language technologies for all, promoting accessible NLP and speech technology research globally.

LT4All (Language Technologies for All) is an international conference initiative supported by ELRA, UNESCO, and leading research institutions, focusing on making language technology research and resources accessible to the global community. The conference brings together researchers from institutions like LIMSI-CNRS, NAIST, and RIKEN AIP to share multilingual NLP and speech technology advances.

## Key Topics

- Language Technologies
- NLP Research
- Multilingual NLP
- Speech Technology
- Conference Proceedings
- Open Data
- Academic Papers
- ELRA
- UNESCO
- Gilles Adda

## Conference Proceedings

- [Proceedings of the 1st International Conference on Language Technologies for All](https://lt4all.elra.info/proceedings/lt4all2019/): LT4All 2019 conference proceedings featuring peer-reviewed papers on multilingual NLP, speech technology, and language resources from international researchers
